title: SLKB resolution limit: audit, criterion and calculator
description: Analysis code, stored results and reproduction instructions for the study "Machine-learning benchmarks for synthetic lethality have a computable resolution limit: a pre-study criterion from the sharing structure of pooled CRISPR screens" (Thakar SB, Ghorpade PN). Includes the released calculator that returns the connected-component count G of a resource's study-by-cell-model incidence graph and the attainable p-value floor it implies, the simulation of type I error over the real sharing structure under ten error laws, the variance-component pilot, the packaged tests and the stored result files. No input data are redistributed; each input is identified by SHA-256 and download date so the exact version can be recovered from its original source.
